task: leap-rs: calculation engine held to LEAP's definitive regression results (Freedonia, Transport Exercise) and stride inference

claims.claim: The full leap-rs test suite passes with the GNU toolchain + rust-lld command.
claims.run: cd leap-rs && export RUSTFLAGS='-C linker=rust-lld' && ~/.cargo/bin/cargo.exe +stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu test --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu 2>&1 | grep -E 'Running|test result|FAILED|panicked|^error'; exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}
claims.expect_output: (?s)Running tests[\\/]case_studies\.rs.*test result: ok\. 2 passed; 0 failed.*Running tests[\\/]stride_inference\.rs.*test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed

claims.claim: tests/case_studies.rs passes with LEAP installed (not via its 'not found, skipped' path): every held Freedonia and Transport Exercise variable matches RegressionResults within results::close.
claims.run: cd leap-rs && export RUSTFLAGS='-C linker=rust-lld' && out=$(~/.cargo/bin/cargo.exe +stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu test --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --test case_studies -- --nocapture 2>&1); rc=$?; echo "$out" | tail -n 20; if echo "$out" | grep -q 'case study skipped'; then echo 'SKIPPED: LEAP area not found'; exit 1; fi; exit $rc

claims.claim: The calculation uses the area's inputs only: with every regression/results file removed from the inputs, calc::run gives bit-identical output to the full zip, and all claimed variables (independently listed in the probe) still match LEAP's definitive results.
claims.expect_output: (?s)Freedonia: stripped-input results \d+ values, full-zip results \d+ values, bit-identical: true.*Freedonia: 40 held variables, [1-9]\d* oracle values checked: ALL MATCH.*Transport Exercise: stripped-input results \d+ values, full-zip results \d+ values, bit-identical: true.*Transport Exercise: 15 held variables, [1-9]\d* oracle values checked: ALL MATCH

claims.claim: No code (comments excluded) in leap-rs/src/calc/, data.rs or the modules calc uses names RegressionResults/definitive/read_regression/_RegressionTests/oracle_ modules, and calc reads tables only by literal non-results names.
claims.expect_output: CLEAN: no oracle reference in the calc path

claims.claim: The HELD lists in tests/case_studies.rs are exactly the claimed Freedonia (40 ids) and Transport Exercise (15 ids) variables, each wired to a #[test].
tests/stride_inference.rs passes with Freedonia present (not via its skip path).
claims.run: cd leap-rs && export RUSTFLAGS='-C linker=rust-lld' && out=$(~/.cargo/bin/cargo.exe +stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu test --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --test stride_inference -- --nocapture 2>&1); rc=$?; echo "$out" | tail -n 10; if echo "$out" | grep -q 'inference test skipped'; then echo 'SKIPPED: area not found'; exit 1; fi; exit $rc
claims.expect_output: test the_inferred_stride_is_every_stride_the_area_pins \.\.\. ok[\s\S]*test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed

claims.claim: Independently: every one of the 28 MEASURED_STRIDE tables is in Freedonia with data blocks and records::stride_of returns its measured stride.
claims.run: export RUSTFLAGS='-C linker=rust-lld' CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$(pwd)/.verify/checks/probe/target" && ~/.cargo/bin/cargo.exe +stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --manifest-path .verify/checks/probe/Cargo.toml 2>&1 | tail -n 2 && "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/x86_64-pc-windows-gnu/release/verify-probe.exe" stride 'C:/Program Files/LEAP/Freedonia.zip'
claims.expect_output: stride_of reproduces 28 measured strides: ALL OK

claims.claim: No existing test file under leap-rs/tests was deleted or lost lines, and no #[ignore] was added.
claims.run: d=$(git diff HEAD --diff-filter=D --name-only -- leap-rs/tests); if [ -n "$d" ]; then echo "deleted: $d"; exit 1; fi; git diff HEAD --numstat -- leap-rs/tests | awk '$2!=0{bad=1; print "removed lines: " $0} END{exit bad}' || exit 1; if git diff HEAD -- leap-rs/tests leap-rs/src | grep -E '^\+.*#\[ignore'; then echo 'ignore added'; exit 1; fi; echo NO_TEST_WEAKENED
